description: AST fingerprints from the prior continuation snapshot, with individually documented reviewed changes. These guard handler bodies; native and service behavior is covered by separate tests.

records.name: reviewLegacyPrivacyPreference
records.reviewedChange: User requested built-in privacy without a general mode switch. Saved local-only choices change only after explicit legacy review and confirmation; source-component tests cover no mount mutation, disclosure, cancellation and explicit resume.

records.name: toggleSms
records.reviewedChange: 2026-09-17: Android SMS is now an independently persisted capture source. Turning it off no longer disables bank-app notifications; turning it on records the SMS source before clearing the global opt-out. OS permission revocation guidance remains unchanged.

records.name: leaveScreen
records.reviewedChange: 2026-09-12: Preserve shared-write and failed-storage guards; after native cancellation recheck the active review before marking skipped or navigating. Covered by onboarding-extreme-import-back.test.cjs.

records.name: refreshSetup
records.reviewedChange: 2026-09-13: When the installed History record is paged, refresh also reads the source-free native paged status (checked/accepted/skipped counts) so the setup screen can show progress after the Shortcut pauses. Recovery, reconciliation and error handling are unchanged. Covered by ios-setup-ux.test.js and ios-journey tests.

records.name: openHistoryInstall
records.reviewedChange: 2026-09-12: Open the public HTTPS Shortcut installer without an unreliable shortcuts scheme probe; retain explicit installation confirmation and restore progress on link failure. Covered by onboarding-extreme-setup.test.cjs and setup UX tests.

records.name: openHistoryRun
records.reviewedChange: 2026-09-13: Continue on an already-running handoff opens historyShortcutContinueUrl() — the paged graph is re-run by its installed name because it resumes its saved cursor and fences the earlier runner; the legacy graph still only reopens Shortcuts. New handoffs, confirmation, and failed-handoff cleanup are unchanged. Covered by ios-setup-ux.test.js.

records.name: resetStoppedHistory
records.reviewedChange: 2026-09-12: Bind Reset consent to the attempt shown when the sheet opened; compare the raw durable marker under the coordinator before any discard or cleanup. Covered by onboarding-extreme-setup.test.cjs.

records.name: finish
records.reviewedChange: 2026-09-23: Independently reviewed readiness check now resolves the selected SMS or notification capture source. Durability, retries, analytics and navigation are unchanged; notification setup and onboarding journey regressions cover both modes. Prior review: 2026-09-19: Stop rewriting the completion profile field by field. The prior note here was about preserving `intention` the same way, and the same omission then silently erased the alert-delivery and country answers, because the reducer replaces the whole profile — so a writer that forgets a field deletes it. onboardingProfileAtStage spreads what is already there, which makes every future field survive by default. The exit destination now resolves through finishDestination(), so a bank that leaves no history to read lands on /statement-import instead of Home; iPhone setup has no completion screen, so this exit is where that offer can exist. Durable completion order and the dismissAll + navigate behavior are unchanged. Covered by onboarding-extreme-setup, onboarding-extreme-navigation and the setup UX tests.

records.name: leave
records.reviewedChange: 2026-09-13: Guided Back returns to the existing root with dismissAll + navigate instead of router.replace (same duplicate-tabs cause as finish). Return-marker clearing is unchanged. Covered by ios-setup-ux.test.js and onboarding-extreme-setup.test.cjs.

records.name: buySelectedPlan
records.reviewedChange: 2026-09-19: Wafra's own Pro screen owns checkout again. The protected native action validates legal readiness and storefront availability, refuses without a live store-supplied price, and reports the store's answer literally: a cancellation is silent, a deferred approval and a transaction the pro entitlement has not confirmed each say so instead of granting Pro. A synchronous latch closes on the first tap so a second tap in the same frame cannot start an overlapping checkout, and it is released in a finally so a throwing store call cannot strand the screen.

records.name: restore
records.reviewedChange: 2026-09-19: Restore reads the same checkoutReady guard and the same single-flight latch as the purchase action, and retains its explicit no-purchase and unreachable-store states.

records.name: manage
records.reviewedChange: 2026-09-19: Subscription management remains an explicit external-link action with the same failure disclosure and loading boundary; it now shares the single-flight latch so it cannot run beside a purchase or restore.

records.name: save
records.reviewedChange: 2026-09-10: Save now requires the durable ledger currency for first manual money and preserves exact minor-unit parsing before the transaction write.

records.name: connectAndroidNotifications
records.reviewedChange: 2026-09-17: Android bank-app notification setup is now an explicit onboarding source. It persists source choice before opening system Notification access and never claims ready until system access is observed.

records.name: finishAndroidCapture
records.reviewedChange: 2026-09-17: Replace the deleted optional goals/budget save with the explicit Android source-selection completion boundary. At least one source must be ready, exact SMS/notification choices are persisted, then the completion checkpoint is saved.

records.name: startScan
records.reviewedChange: 2026-09-18: SMS onboarding still persists the SMS source and history checkpoint, and now explicitly asks for RECEIVE_SMS plus visible notification permission so live purchase alerts work while Wafra is backgrounded. Either refusal keeps READ_SMS catch-up usable and is repaired later through an explicit Enable action.

records.name: beginCapture
records.reviewedChange: 2026-09-10: Capture setup keeps serialized native handoff behavior, records source-free funnel state, and still requires explicit manual choice when capture is unavailable.

records.name: continueManually
records.reviewedChange: 2026-09-17: Manual onboarding explicitly disables both durable Android sources and the native source/lease configuration before global opt-out; existing iOS relay revocation and durable manual completion behavior are unchanged.

records.name: goBack
records.reviewedChange: 2026-09-19: Back follows the integrated welcome → name → focus → tracking → alerts → intention → preview → capture journey. The alert-delivery question is inserted between Tracking and Intention and steps back through both; returning from Focus still reopens the in-Welcome name personalization without adding a progress step, and completion callback cleanup is unchanged.

records.name: openWafra
records.reviewedChange: 2026-09-19: The completion destination widens from the Pro route alone to the OnboardingExit union, so a ledger whose bank does not text can be sent to /statement-import. Destination is still only ever carried, never chosen here, and completion still waits for persistence. Covered by onboarding-actions.test.cjs and onboarding-extreme-navigation.test.cjs.
